Bank of Canada Unveils New $20 Bill Featuring King Charles

The Bank of Canada has unveiled a new vertical $20 banknote that features King Charles III. The bill also includes an image of the Vimy Memorial. This marks the first time a Canadian banknote has featured King Charles III. The new design replaces the previous $20 bill which featured Queen Elizabeth II. The central bank has not yet announced a release date for the new currency.
